units: Tosef. Dem. I, 29 כֵּפַת המרחץ ed. Zuck. (Var. בפת, emend. by El. Wil. קופת) resin used (with oil) in the bath-room.—כֵּיפַת הירדן Jordan-resin, amber (an adapt. of Eridanus, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Electrum, Lübker’s Reallex. s. v. Electron).
<cite ref="Keritot 6a">Kerith. 6ᵃ</cite> (one of the ingredients of frankincense).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:3:2">Y. Sabb. V, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. (in Chald. dict.), v. <cite ref="C00096"><he>גְּבִינְתָּא</he></cite>.
